about: Pose handoff (docs/scene-state-v2.md "受け渡しの置き方", ADR 0067). Each case: `state` is read with load_scene_state / loadSceneState, `shot` with load_sticker_state / loadStickerState (from its JSON text), and the state is evaluated at each of `frames` with the output length `length` and that shot; `expected` is the evaluation, which Python and JS give within 1e-4.

cases.name: moving_camera_no_offset
cases.about: No offset: the Sticker takes the Camera's turn, hFOV and lens curve at the sticker_state's time (clip frame × 30 ÷ 24); its own Lanes are not used.

cases.name: offset_turn_and_zoom
cases.about: An offset turn in the Camera's own axes (moving) and a factor on its angle of view.

cases.name: looking_camera_with_targets
cases.about: The Camera that shot it looks at a point, then at a moving Sticker carried in `targets`, and loops over the sticker_state's length.

cases.name: not_a_port_or_world
cases.about: Only the sky port Sticker is placed by the shot: a file Sticker and a world port Sticker keep their Lanes.
